title: Our experience with the STEAM NEXT FEST!
author: SynapseGameStudios
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/p180l9yq4uxh1.png

Hey everyone!

We just wanted to share a quick update and talk about our experience with [Neural Defense](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4922380/Neural_Defense/) in this Steam Next Fest so far now that is almost over.

Honestly, it has gone much better than we expected. Despite receiving some advice telling us not to post anything beforehand or to hold off a bit longer, we decided to make a couple of prior posts and put ourselves out there. In the end, the results really surprised us in the best way possible: we've received a wonderful wave of support, great additions to wishlists, and such a warm welcome from players all around the world, not just locally, but globally.

We are super happy and truly grateful with how everything is turning out so far. Wishing the absolute best of luck to everyone participating with their games in this edition too!
